curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the license as a privilege, what the record lists, out-of-state reporting, how long convictions stay, privacy, ticket types and court timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per record rule; retention-period cards.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what goes on the record and how long it stays.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when points post and expire, the reexamination thresholds, and how state points differ from insurance points.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Point timing and threshold cards; contrast cards for points versus convictions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on point timing and thresholds.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the six, four, three and two point groups, then contrast speeding bands, test refusals, impairment levels and yield failures.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per point group; contrast cards for each confusable pair.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching violations to point values.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach standard drink equivalence, effects of even one drink, the time-only rule, and planning so no one drives impaired.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Effect and plan cards; contrast card for sobering myths versus time.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on alcohol myths and safe plans.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach that drug convictions suspend licenses without driving, the first and repeat suspension lengths, and the reinstatement fee.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Suspension cards; contrast card for first versus repeat offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on drug suspension lengths.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach marijuana transport and use limits, impaired driving penalties, how officers judge impairment and implied consent.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Marijuana and testing cards; contrast card for legal transport versus impaired driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on marijuana rules and implied consent.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach why reexams happen, legal grounds and thresholds, what the analyst does, medical reexams and new-driver resources.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Trigger and outcome cards; contrast card for ordinary versus new-driver thresholds.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec04-m01..sec04-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
